errors.text_span: Der erste Balkendiagramm zeigt einen Balkengraph mit der Achse % des BIP als vertikale Achse
errors.evidence: The left chart is a bar chart, not a 'Balkengraph' with vertical bars; the bars are stacked vertically, but the description incorrectly implies a different structure. Also, the y-axis is vertical, not the x-axis.

errors.text_span: was die Darstellung des Europäischen Union-BIP als zusammengesetzte Mixtur darstellt
errors.evidence: The chart does not represent the European Union BIP; it represents investments of German 'Gebietskörperschaften' (federal, state, and municipal levels) as a percentage of Germany's BIP.

errors.text_span: including the piv direction of the x-axis' provides some context to the data's progression overlaid by an overlaying area graph
errors.evidence: There is no area graph in either diagram; the description incorrectly refers to an overlaying area graph instead of stacked bars and a line.

errors.text_span: The second diagram presents a line chart in addition to the same mixed compositional data
errors.evidence: The second diagram is not a line chart; it is a bar chart with a line representing 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt'. The description incorrectly labels it as a line chart.

errors.text_span: with the line graph showing the overall share of "state corporations as a whole (Gesindern)"
errors.evidence: The line represents 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt,' not 'state corporations as a whole.' The term 'Gesindern' is incorrect and nonsensical.

The description does not state that the charts show investments of 'Gebietskörperschaften' (federal, state, and municipal) in relation to GDP (BIP) over time, nor does it distinguish between gross and net investments.
The description omits the y-axis range (-0.5 to 3.5 % of BIP) and the x-axis time range (1991 to 2023). It also fails to mention the axis labels explicitly.
The description does not mention the black line representing 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt' in the left chart or the trends (e.g., high values in the early 1990s, decline, stabilization).
The description fails to mention that the right chart shows net investments, which are significantly lower than gross investments and occasionally negative.
The description does not specify the tick intervals or the exact values for any of the data points.
There is no area graph in the figure; this is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: ohne eine klare Formulierung der Skalen- oder Einheitenbeschreibung
errors.evidence: The phrase is awkwardly phrased and unclear; it does not clearly state what is missing (e.g., axis range, units).

errors.text_span: Der erste Balkendiagramm zeigt einen Balkengraph mit der Achse % des BIP als vertikale Achse ohne eine klare Formulierung der Skalen- oder Einheitenbeschreibung.
errors.evidence: Grammatical error: 'Der erste Balkendiagramm' should be 'Das erste Balkendiagramm.' Also, 'Balkengraph' is not standard terminology.

errors.text_span: Die farbcodierten Balken sind übereinstimmend mit den farbcodierten Segmenten vertikal angeordnet, wobei die Werte und spezielleren Details wie Tick-Beschriftungsintervallen nicht angegeben sind.
errors.evidence: The description is unnecessarily verbose and repetitive (e.g., 'farbcodierten' used twice in one sentence).
